Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in synthesizing the information gathered by the WebSurfer. In Step 2, the WebSurfer correctly identified that Noerr was founded in 1950 and Korn Ferry in 1969. However, in Step 3, the Planner incorrectly swapped these years in its analysis, stating "Noerr: Founded in 1969" and "Korn Ferry: Founded in 1950." This misinterpretation of the data led to the wrong conclusion that Korn Ferry was established first, when in reality, Noerr (1950) was established before Korn Ferry (1969).
